title: Add JSON output for chain status
summary: Add stable machine-readable output for `covenant chain status --json` so automation can inspect settlement readiness and missing configuration without parsing human text.
expectedFailureModes: Settlement automation depends on human `chain status` lines that can change without schema review.
The JSON output omits fields required to determine whether settlement is enabled.
Live coverage exercises receipt reads and batches but not the public chain-readiness CLI contract.
nextAction: Continue with the next autonomy backlog item.
